text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—In the cafeteria.
Nakayama Festa called out to Eishin Flash
with a somewhat meaningful tone."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yo, Flash.
Have you changed your mind about that matter?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Nakayama-san. I appreciate the invitation,
but I must decline after all."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if I may ask—
why me? Surely there are plenty of others you could play poker with."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Fair point. But... gamblers blessed with "flawless self-control" are a rare breed to come by, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I want to tear away that kind of self-control and have a thrill-packed showdown where the heat is on full blast.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize.
Leaving things to blind luck like that is incompatible with my principles, so—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, figures. A guy like that usually
won't touch a double-or-nothing gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yet that's also your limit.
When faced with an all-or-nothing gamble,
your legs freeze up and you can't take the leap—am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Aren't you brimming with confidence?
If you're that certain—
I'd like to see you prove it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're her Trainer.
Cut from the same cloth, no doubt.
—Well, I won't force it on you, though.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright. I'll provide the chocolate coins for chips.
Well then—shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry about that. This match is my win too.
Well, maybe luck will be on your side next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Already eight consecutive losses. Sweat soaked the hand
holding the cards... The momentum was entirely
in Nakayama Festa's grasp.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait. That is quite enough.
Do you still intend to continue this contest?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"She's still raring to go, too.
After all, her honor's on the line.
Hers... and yours."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. If that is so... then I shall shoulder that honor and fight from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very well.
That's the spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very well.
That's the spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will live up to your expectations.
For the sake of your honor as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With both maintaining a perfect poker face, the match progressed—unfolding into a true back-and-forth battle.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"You have a straight,
while I have three of a kind with sixes...
Looks like my loss."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"It's been a constant back-and-forth of wins and losses.
—I'd say it's about time for a showdown to settle it all once and for all, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...It's already turned into quite a long haul.
My throat is getting a little dry..."
choice_data_list: Then shall I bring you something?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Well then, sorry to trouble you, but I'll leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So, I got some tea from the dispenser and returned. The next game had already started—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa suddenly lost her balance, and I caught a glimpse of her hand—she was holding four of a kind with 'J's!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Did you see it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With such a strong hand, my heart races—
Before I knew it, I forgot to answer and
found myself staring right at Flash—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
......Now then. For this match—
I'll be betting all of my chips.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, what will you do, Flash?
On this grand stage—will you cower
and run away after all?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—No. If you intend to challenge me head-on...
Then, as always, I shall simply meet you with head held high,
upon my honor."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, heh heh heh... Still raising the stakes even at the final moment, are we...? I like that too...!
Now then, let's settle this once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And... when both revealed their hands, Eishin Flash showed—four Kings. A narrow victory!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"So I lost. —Heh heh. That was a good race.
I'm glad... You were strong."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this again. Racing's great and all,
but it's nice to do this every now and then... y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—If possible, I'd prefer we keep it to races—fufu.
It certainly was... a ‘heated contest.’”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Understood.
For the sake of our pride, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Getting heated when it's not like you will only get you burned.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Full house.
...How about you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—A-A straight...!
I... concede defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And... mercilessly, the match unfolded exactly as Nakayama Festa had predicted.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Impatience is starting to creep into her racing.
Once that happens, it's only a matter of time before it shows on her face... She's burning out soon.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, this is good. That's the exact look
I wanted to draw out of you.
—Bet."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Make me feel the burn more...!
Show me that desperate, comeback-from-the-brink late surge!
Drive it right into me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Or—are you going to run away after all?
Is that all you and your Trainer amount to!?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Raise...!
I'm going all in... with all my chips!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, no throwing cold water on this.
Alright, fine... I'll take on that tingling strike of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, when both revealed their hands...
an unexpected outcome awaited.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Straight flush.
That means... it's my win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
............
Phew... You really had me going there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up an impatient bluff until you're dealt a winning hand, huh?
Man... you really are quite the gambler.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing so grand.
I merely followed my own strategy—which is to say,
according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Do you not care for someone with this kind of skill?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, not at all. That was far more
entertaining a contest than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're interesting. Truly fascinating.
I'm looking forward to our next showdown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Next time, on the track.
...Hehe.
